== Summary ==
[[Kevin Jaap]] looks at his Hall of Fame trophy, with [[Tamás Papp]] (left) and [[Chris Menzel]] (right).

* '''Event:''' [[2024 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2024-09-21
* '''Camera date:''' 2024-09-21 (Day 1; posted that evening)
* '''Identification:''' [[Kevin Jaap]]: face match with his [[:File:Kevin Jaap 2024 Hall of Fame.jpg|Hall of Fame photo]], where he wears the same white polo; [[Tamás Papp]]: face match with his [[:File:Tamas Papp (community card).jpg|community card]], and he was the tournament director, here working the organizers' desk in the same blue T-shirt all day; [[Chris Menzel]]: his name and "Hall of Fame" are embroidered on his shirt, and the wrap-up says he presented Kevin Jaap's Hall of Fame award.
